tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun rig gi chog bsgrigs ngag 'don bya tshul 'jug ngogs bde ba'i lam zhes bya ba bzhugs/

bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir kun rig gi cho ga'i ngag 'don zur du dgod par bya ste/ de'ang cho ga dngos gzhi ni 'dul 'dzin pa'i rgyud don gsal ba rgyas shing legs pas logs su byed dgos par mi 'dug kyang*/ de ni sa chog gi skabs dang sbyar ba'i stabs kyis gsar bu rnams la blo 'dzin byed mi bde zhing ngag 'don la kha skong dgos par mthong nas/ de rnams la phan khyad go don phyag rgya mchog gi skor rnams rgyud don gsal ba las shes par bya ba dang*/ de las 'byung ba'i go don lhan thabs su byas shing*/ phyag rgya rnams dang sngags don bod skad du bsgyur ba zhig bdag gis kyang logs su bris yod pas/ de rnams 'dir dor nas cho ga'i ngo bo tsam bri bar bya'o/ /de la thog mar rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur bar bsams na legs te/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i dgongs par yang snang ngo*/ /de nas rdor dril byin brlab ni/ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥṭakki dzaḥhoḥlan gsum/ hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de tshul las byung ba'i rdo rje/ /srog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /āḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dkur bzung nas bsnyems pa dang bcas par zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i bdag po dam pa kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug gi dam pa de nyid chos kyi mchog gi bka' yang dag par stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/

rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni mdzad pa yin/ /zhes brjod de dril bu gsil/ dharmāḥ.āḥsrid pa'i bde ba shin tu myur/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di nyid shin tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa mchog tu gsang ba'i theg pa chen po'i chen po dam tshig chen po'i sbyor ba ni bcom ldan 'das dam tshig go /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang*/ 'da' bar ru ni mi mdzad pas/ /phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ /yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro/ /sngon 'gro'i mchod pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ gis bsang*/ hūṃ badzra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bha ñdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pātyaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra nai we tye āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ gtor ma ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ hūṃ badzra a na la= hūṃ phaṭa swa bhā was stong bar sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dngas shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/

oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmaḥ ṇa a dya nud pan na twatta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlab/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /e hye hi da sha di ka yo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ye swā hās spyan drangs/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ras da ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pātyaṃ/ puṣāṃ/ dhubaṃ/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wetye/ sapta pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā mchod nas/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarb+ba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ bi shwa mu khai bhyaḥsarb+ba ta da khaṃ ud ga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ gri hna daṃ pa liṃ te swā hā/ lan gsum brjod de phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje can te lha tshogs bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po ste/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang*/ /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la/ /so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ / rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /me tog dri dang bdug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi dge ba'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa dang de'i bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /'phrin las bcol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra muḥphyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/

ri chu la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ lan bdun brjod do/ hūṃ tsan dan chu la bden pa bdar ba yis/ /phyogs su gtor bas yongs su dag gyur te/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur nas/ /dri med yon tan dag dang ldan par shog /oṃ sarb+ba saṃ shodha ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas gtor/ de nas mchod pa sngar ltar byin brlab bya zhing*/ sgrub mchod rgyas pa min par rgyun pa'i tshogs skabs 'dir maṇḍal 'bul dgos pa min no/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing*/ /blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom/ /ma lus rigs kyi padma'i nang bzhugs pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ /dman pa'i 'jigs pa rnams kyi rgyal byed tshal/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sprul gyi dug bcom zhing*/ /blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje chen ldan pa/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zh-ing*/ /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs/ /mnyam med byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarb+ba dharmāḥswabhā wa shud dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ lce byin brlab ni/ de'i lkog mar hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lce'i thad ka'i 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du/

a las zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ de lce la thim pas lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra dzī hwa/ lag pa byin brlab ni/ lag pa gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re re/ de zhu lag pa la thim pas rdo rje'i lag pa/ sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ de nas rang gi thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum shing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de na rang so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ oṃ bud dha a bhi ṣaṃñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra a bhiṣāṣtsa hūṃ/ oṃ ratna a bhiṣiñtsa trī/ oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karmā a bhiṣañtsa aḥ rdo rjes tshur gnyis kyis snying mgrin ltag pa snying kha nu mar snying kha mgrin rgyab dpral bar/ oṃ ṭuṃ/ lan dgu/ oṃ badzra tuṣpa hoḥ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang ba dkyus su khru nyi shu pas gnas rnams su mdud nas rna ba'i steng du sor bzhi tsam phyung lhag ma phye ste brgyad pas lus dang mnyam par gyur/ khro bo spyan 'dren ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa ma dzaḥ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rigs pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /leg 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/

/oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra e hye hi/ pra wa ra sad ga raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra pra wa ra sa da ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gande/ nai we hye/ shapta pra tītstsha āḥhūṃ/ gis mchod bstod pa ni/ hūṃ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi ngaro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*/ /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sprul gdug rgyan gyi brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyis sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha' me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyur 'dra'i khro gnyis mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs/ khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bka' bsgo ni/ hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom/ khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/

/mgo bo tshal ba brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*/ /bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /srung 'khor ni/ oṃ badzra dzwā ā na lārk+ka hūṃ/ hūṃ badzra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bha ñdza ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra nai tri ban dha sarb+ba bighna na/ oṃ badzra ḍi ḍho me bha wa rakṣa sarba swā hā/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ hu lu hu su hūṃ phaṭa/ steng du rdo rje'i phur du gyur/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ gur gyi 'og tu rdo rje'i bla rer gyur/ oṃ druṃ bandha taṃ/ shar rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badzra pā sha hrīḥ shar gyi ra ba'i nang du 'ang rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ oṃ bā tā ke pa taṃ gi ni ratna nub rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ hrī badzra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ byang rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ oṃ badzra shi kha ra ru ṭa ma ṭa/ lho rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ hūṃ badzra karmū phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ/ nang rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ban dha paṃ/ slar yang ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ de nas tshogs shing ni/ oṃ sarb+ba bi da maṇḍal badzra tsakra hūṃ/ mdun du bcom ldan 'das kyi kun rig gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du grub pa 'gyur/ oṃ sarb+ba bing maṇḍal badzra tsakra hūṃ/ brgya rtsa brgyad brjod de/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta bā da bandhanāṃ ka ro mes phyag bya/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta pra wa sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ sarb+ba ta tā ga ta ra bā dyaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarbā ta thā ga ta puṣbe pū dza me bha sa mu tra sphar ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gandhe/ nai we tye/ shapta pū dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma yai hūṃ gis mchod/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*/ /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang*/ /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags/

/bder gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*/ /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan la yang*/ /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya ba'i phyir bskul bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang po'i gzir las dgrol/ /sdom gzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag med 'di zhes bya ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhi ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/

/las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du so sor gzung*/ /mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*/ /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol pa rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgong*/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rang gnas su mi dmigs par gyur par bsams la/ lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ g.yas pa'i dbus su hūṃ sngon po/ /g.yon pa'i dbus su āḥdakar po/ /de dag gi mthar bskor du/ a āḥ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ lan gnyis brjod/ dbyangs yig bcu drug 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pas gang bar gyur/ sor mo rnams me long ltar dngas pa'i mthe bong gnyis la oṃ dkar po/ /mdzub mo gnyis la hūṃ sngon po/ /gung mo gnyis la traṃ ser po/ / srin lag gnyis la hrīḥdamar po/ /mthe'u chung gnyis la āḥljang khu/ g.yas pa rnams la rim pa bzhin rnam snang dkar po/ /mi bskyod pa sngon po/ /rin 'byung ser po/ /'od dpag med dmar po/ /don grub ljang khu/ g.yon pa rnams la rim pa bzhin/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo/ /rdo rje thugs ma sngon po/ /rdo rje dbang bskur ma ser mo/ /rdo rje mtshon cha ma dmar mo/ /rdo rje kun ma ljang khu rnams phan tshun lha dang lha mo'i khyad par ma gtogs pa phyag mtshan rgyan la sogs pa rigs lnga dang 'dra bar gyur/

oṃ āḥn+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarb+ba dharm+māḥparaḥsphar a nu pra biṣtāḥ sarba dharm+māḥbadzra añdza le a tya nta a nu pra biṣtāḥsarba dharm+māḥbadzra ban dha/ badzra ban dha tra ṭa/ lan gsum/ badzra ā be sha/ aḥ aḥ teṣṭha dri ḍho me bha wa hrā da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣṭha sarba siddha me pra ya tstsha hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbadzra muṣtī/ oṃ badzra muṣti baṃ gsum mam gcig /oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ādmā ko3haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud dho3kaṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du hūṃ raṃ hūṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ baṃ hūṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ /de'i steng du hūṃ laṃ hūṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ suṃ hūṃ las raṃ ra ba rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs padma de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhruṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i phyi'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ de'i phyed kyi tshad du nang gi gzhal yas khang*/ gnyis ka'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pas bskor ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum dang gru bzhi la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng na padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mnga' yab la gnas pa'i gser gyi bum pa nas 'then pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/

phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rts-ig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyi'i sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs/ gser dang*/ shar bu dang*/ rin po che dang*/ rta rmig dang*/ mun snam dang*/ ba ranṭa dang*/ mun pa dang*/ shar bu dang*/ rin po che dang*/ rmig pa dang*/ mda' yab ste snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyis shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang*/ sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ pad ri'i phyi rol tu khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ me ri dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du rdo rje dang rin po che dang padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje mtshan pa'i ka ba brgyad brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phul ba'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba/ gzhal yas khang nang ma'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su āḥ siṃ ā las seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ shar du hūṃ gaṃ hūṃ las glang chen gyis btegs pa'i= lhor trāṃḥwāṃ trāṃḥlas rta mchog gis= nub tu hrīḥmaṃ hrīḥlas rma byas=

byang du aḥgaṃ aḥlas mkha' lding gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ lha'i gnas thams cad du hrīḥlas padma dang*/ aḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyis don mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas/ slar 'dus chos kyi yi ge la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das kun rig sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bsnams shing rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyad pa/ dar gyi'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ zhi ba'i gzigs stangs mdzad cing rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ tshangs pa chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang*/ sdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad kun du snang bar byas so/ /kun du snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las rnam par grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas rang gi gnas thams cad kun du snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod nas lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas te mgo bos lan brgya phrag stong du phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das kyis spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/

/gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /dang po sbyor ba'o/ /rang gi thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du mdzad/ slar 'dus chos kyi yi ge la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po sku mdog dkar po/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ oṃ sarb+ba bi da hūṃ/ thugs kha nas phyung shar gyi gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ rang gi thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su twāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa las dpag tu med pa'i = yongs su gyur pa las rgyal mchog rin chen sku mdog sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas rin po che mar gad cha dgu pa bsnams pa/ oṃ sarb+ba bi da phaṭa/ thugs ka nas phyung lho'i gdan= rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i= dbus su hrīḥlas padma hrīḥmatshan pa las= shākya rigs dbang dmar ser phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i padma bsnams pa/ oṃ sarb+ba bid āḥ thugs kha nas phyung nub kyi gdan= rang gi = āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje āḥmatshan pa las= me tog cher rgyas ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams shing g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ oṃ sa bid traṭa/ thugs kha nas phyung byang gi gdan= de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi po yang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi'i stod g.yogs dang smad can/ zhi ba'i gzigs stangs mdzad cing rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ rang gi= hūṃ las spyan gyis spras pa'i 'khor lo hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las dpag tu=

spyan ma dkar mo phyag g.yas thugs khar spyan 'dzin cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ne hūṃ/ phyung shar lho'i gdan gyi= rang gi= trāṃ las rdo rje trāṃ gis mtshan pa las= mā ma kī sngon po g.yas rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin cing g.yon pa= oṃ badzra mā ma kā trāṃ/ = phyung lho nub kyi gdan gyi= rang gi = hrīḥlas padma hrīḥmatshan pa las= gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pa padma 'dzin cing g.yon pa= oṃ badzra paṇḍa re de hi de hi si da dhāṃ bo dhi lo ko tta ri pāṃ swā hā/ = phyung nub byang gi gdan gyi= rang gi= āḥlas utpal āḥmatshan pa las= sgrol ma ljang khu g.yas utpal 'dzin cing = oṃ badzra tā re tu ttā re tu re hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swa swa swa swā hā/ = byang shar gyi gdan= rang gi= hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las= rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum sgreng ba'i dbus ma'i rtse mo la dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rang gi thugs khar stong pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dril bu kha nang du bstan te snyems pa'i tshul gyis dkur bsten pa/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ thugs= shar gyi rtsibs dang po'i gdan la 'khod/ rang gi= dzaḥlas lcags kyu dzaḥmatshan pa las= rdo rje rgyal po gser mdog phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra rā dzā dzaḥ = phyung rtsibs gnyis pa'i gdan la= rang gi= hoḥlas mda' gzhu hoḥmatshan pa las= rdo rje chags pa dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mda' utpal dmar po kha ma bye ba'i mde'u can rdo rje'i gzhu rna ba'i bar du bkang nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'bigs par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra rā ga hoḥ = phyung rtsibs gsum pa'i= rang gi= dhu las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dhus mtshan pa las= rdo rje legs pa ljang khu dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis bsnams nas legs so sbyin pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par mdzad pa/

oṃ badzra swa dhu dhu/ = phyung rtsibs bzhi pa'i= rang gi= trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa las= rdo rje rin chen ser po phyag g.yas rdo rje rin po che rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'jog cing*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dril bu kha nang du bstan te snyems pa'i tshul gyis dkur bsten pa/ oṃ badzra ranta trāṃ/ = phyung lho'i rtsibs dang po'i= rang gi= rya mas nyi ma ryas mtshan pa las= rdo rje gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdog can/ phyag g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba na rdo rje rtse lnga pa yod pa'i 'od kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang bar mdzad pa thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ badzra te dza rya/ = rtsibs gnyis pa'i= rang gi bhri las rgyal mtshan bhrīs mtshan pa las= rdo rje rgyal mtshan sngon po phyag g.yas dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rtog can gyi rgyal mtshan dang mu tig chun 'phyang la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa phrag pa'i phyogs su sgreng ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par sbyor bar mdzad cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ badzra ke tu bhri= = phyung rtsibs gsum pa'i= rang gi= hā las so'i phreng ba hās mtshan pa las= rdo rje bzhad pa dung dang padma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis kyi dbus su chud pa'i so'i phreng ba gnyis kha 'gram g.yas su 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dzum pa rmad du byung ba la nges par sbyor ba mdzad cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ badzra hā sa hā/ = phyung rtsibs bzhi pa'i= rang gi= hrīḥlas padma hrīḥmatshan pa las= rdo rje chos dkar dmar phyag g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje padma'i stong bu dkur bsten cing*/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtheb 'dzub gnyis kyi snying khar rdo rje padma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/

oṃ badzra dharmāḥhrīḥ = phyung nub kyi rtsibs dang po'i= rang gi= hrīḥlas ral gri dhīḥmatshan pa las= rdo rje rnon po sngon po phyag g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis thugs khar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams shing*/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje ral gris de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'debs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra tīkṣa dhīḥ thugs phyung rtsibs gnyis pa'i= rang gi kruṃ las 'khor lo kruṃ gis mtshan pa las= rdo rje rgyu gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pa'i gung mo'i rtse mo na dang po'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rtsibs can gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ badzra he tu kruṃ/ phyung rtsibs gsum pa'i= rang gi= bha las lce bhas mtshan pa las= rdo rje smra ba zangs kyi mdog can phyag g.yas dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lce bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang smra bar mdzad cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa bha/ thugs rtsibs bzhi pa'i= rang gi kaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje kaṃ gis mtshan pa las= rdo rje las zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po/ /zhal gyi 'og nas rked pa'i bar du dmar skya/ rked pa'i bar dang phyag gnyis sngo skya/ brla gnyis ser skya/ lhag ma mdog sngon po/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs khar stod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas sna tshogs rdo rje yul byas pa'i dril bu kha nang du bstan nas dkur bsten pa/ oṃ badzra karmāḥkaṃ /phyung byang gi rtsibs dang po'i= rang gi= re las go cha raṃ gyis mtshan pa las= rdo rje srung ba gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis kyis mtha' gnyis su rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i rdo rje'i go cha bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la go bkon pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra rakṣaṃ raṃ/ rtsibs gnyis pa'i=

rang gi= kṣaṃ las mche ba kṣaṃ gis mtshan pa las= rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po lto ba yangs shing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas rtsa bar mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sdigs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra yakṣa kṣaṃ/ thugs= phyung rtsibs gsum pa'i= rang gi= ṣtaṃ las rdo rje ṣtaṃ gis mtshan pa las= rdo rje khu tshur ser po dam tshig gi rdo rje khu tshur gyis dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa snying 'tshir ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra sand+riṣtaṃ/ rtsibs bzhi pa'i= rang gi= hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las= sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis snyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing mgo g.yon du cung zad 'dud pa/ oṃ badzra lāsya hūṃ/ thugs= shar lho'i nang gi grwa'i= rang gi trāṃ las rin po che'i phreng ba trāṃ gis mtshan pa las= phreng ba ma ser mo rdo rje rin po che'i 'phreng bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur bar mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ/ lho nub kyi nang gi grwa'i= rang gi= hrīḥlas bi waṃ hrīḥmatshan pa las= glu ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i bi waṃ rdung ba la brtson pa/ oṃ badzra gīrta hrīḥnub byang gi nang gi grwa'i= rang gi= aḥlas rdo rje rtse gsum pa aḥmatshan pa las= gar ma zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po= lhag ma mdog sngon po/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bsnams nas gar byed pa/ oṃ badzra nri tya aḥ byang shar gyi nang gi grwa'i= rang gi= hūṃ las spos snod hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las= bdug pa ma dkar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i spos snod bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tshim par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūṃ/ phyung shar lho'i phyi'i grwa'i= rang gi= trāṃ yas me tog gi snod trāṃ gis mtshan pa las=

me tog ma ser mo phyag g.yon na rdo rje me tog gi snod 'dzin cing g.yas me tog gi char 'bebs par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ lho nub kyi phyi'i grwa'i= rang gi hrīḥlas mar me'i sdong bu hrīḥmatshan pa las= mar me ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rje mar me'i sdong bu bsnams te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nang ba'i tshogs kyis mchod par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥnub byang gi phyi'i grwa'i= rang gi= aḥlas dri'i dung phor aḥmatshan pa/ byug pa ma zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po= lhag ma mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yon rdo rjes mtshon pa'i dri'i dung pher bsnams te g.yas kyis ri'i sprin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥbyang shar gyi phyi'i grwa'i= rang gi= dzaḥlas lcags kyu dzaḥ mtshan pa las= rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyu bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan 'dren par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥnang gi shar sgo'i= rang gi= hūṃ las zhags pa hūṃ gyis mtshan pa las= rdo rje zhags pa ser po phyag gnyis rdo rje zhags pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jug par mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ phyung lho sgo'i= rang gi= paṃ las lcags sgrog paṃ gyis mtshan pa las= rdo rje lcags sgrog dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags sgrog gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'ching bar mdzad pa/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ nub sgo'i= rang gi= hoḥlas rdo rje dril bu hoḥmatshan pa las= rdo rje 'bebs pa zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po= lhag ma mdog sngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje dril bu bsnams te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'bebs par mdzad cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥ thugs kha nas phyung byang sgo'i gdan la 'khod/ spyan ma nas 'bebs pa'i bar gyi lha thams cad kyang rab tu dgyes pas spyan gdangs pa/

sgeg pa'i nyams can 'dzum dang bcas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ rang gi thugs= ka pā bha tra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las dang po'i rdo rje bzhi/ rdo rje rin po che bzhi/ rdo rje padma bzhi/ sna tshogs rdo rje bzhi ste phyag mtshan bcu drug kalpa bha tra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pas mtshan pa las dpag tu= yongs su gyur pa las skal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug tu gyur/ oṃ sarb+ba saṃ skra ri ba ri sho dhā na dharmāḥte ga ga na sa mud ga te ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ thugs ka nas phyung rta babs dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi khyams kyi lha snam nang ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi sku mdog dkar po= tshul gyis dkur bsten pa/ lhor/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi sku mdog ser po phyag g.yas rdo rje rin po che rang gi dbang bskur= dkur bsten pa/ nub du 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ dra ba can gyi 'od bzhi sku mdog dkar dmar= kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ byang du rdo rje'i snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun du bzang po bzhi zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar= lhag ma mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs khar stod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing dkur bsten pa/ de thams cad kyang rab tu dgyes pa spyan gdangs pa= rgyab yol mnga' ba/ rang gi= shra wa ka'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las 'khar sil bcu drug shra wa ka'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pas mtshan pa las= nyan thos bcu drug du gyur/ badzra shra wa ka

/thugs kha nas phyung lha snam par pa'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mo'u 'gal kyi bu/ lhor rab 'byor/ 'char ka ma 'gags pa/ kau de n+ya/ nub du nye bar 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag kun dga' bo/ byang du ming chen/ nor sbyin 'dzin/ gang bo/ 'od srung*/ rang gi thugs kar= pra tāe ka'i ming yig dang po thig las brgyan pa las 'khar gsil bcu gnyis/ pra tāe ka'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pas mtshan pa las/ rang rgyal bcu gnyis su gyur/ badzra pra tāe ka /thugs kha nas phyung lha snam phyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du gdung ba sel pa/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ shar lhor/ 'jigs pa med pa/ lhor dpa' bo 'dul pa/ shes rab mgyogs can/ lho nub tu ri bo rgyal/ nub tu smra ba'i sgra chen/ bse ru lta bu/ nub byang du dug chen 'joms/ byang du rdzu 'phrul cher ston/ seng ge sgra/ byang shar du yid myur/ nyan rang thams cad sku mdog ma nges pa phyag na lhung bzed dang 'khar gsel po ti 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol khyad par rang rgyal rnams dbu'i gtsug tor cung zad dang bcas pa/ rang gi = badzra krodhā'i ming = rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bcu drug /badzra krodhā'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pas mtshan pa las= khro bo bcu drug tu gyur/ badzra krodhā/ thugs kha nas phyung dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i sgo bzhi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar sgor/ khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang*/ de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ /rgyab dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lho sgor/ khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ de'i g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub sgor/ khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'ching*/ de'i g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrogs ma/ byang sgor/ khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'jig

/de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ phyag g.yas rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis mgo thod shas gang ba dang ma rungs pa'i rgyu ma drangs te zhal du gsol ba/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing stag gi lpags pas smad dkris pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ma rungs pa'i snying khar mnan pa/ khyad par lcags kyu ma la sogs pa bzhi rang ming gi mtshan ma lcags kyu la sogs pa 'dzin pa/ lha tshogs de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūṃ sngon po/ lha rang rang gi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du oṃ la sogs pa'i rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi dkyil 'khor las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥm lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan skal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnams sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyis dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ / dad pa'i spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /dus zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/

/chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun du mi bzad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'di ru gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ādma ko3 e hye hi/ spyan drangs la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā sa mchod yon dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarbā ta thā ta a bhi ṣakta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ gis khrus dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ gis gdan dbul/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ ces pa nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūṃ gis mchod nas/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra yakṣā ho bdun dbugs sogs bya/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ oṃ pra wa ra sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarbā bid oṃ/ oṃ sarbā bid āḥ oṃ sarbā bid hūṃ/ dam rgya mi sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra ḍiṣta ma ṭa/ so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ sarbā bid hri shya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+wa/ a haṃ/ sarbā bid/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/

dang yang oṃ sarba bid hūṃ dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥdang*/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ ces pa'i sngags gsum re brjod/ spyan sogs bzhi la so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ su ra ta st+waṃ/ badzra ri ṣti ma ṭā/ buddha lo tsa ni tri shya dang*/ badzra ma mā ke/ badzra paṇḍa re= badzra tā re tri shya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ bud dha lo tsa ne dang*/ badzra ma mā ki dang*/ badzra paṇḍa re dang*/ badzra tā re rnams gsum re dang*/ oṃ buddha lo tsa ne hūṃ dang*/ oṃ badzra ma mā ki traṃ dang*/ oṃ badzra paṇḍa re de hi de hi sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra tā re tuttā re sogs lan gsum re brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rdor sems nas khro bo'i bar la rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas sbyar bar bya ste/ de yang*/ su ra ta st+waṃ/ badzra ḍiṣti ma ṭa/ badzra sa twa tri shya nas/ badzra ghaṇḍa tri shya'i bar dang*/ kalpa bha tra tri shya dang*/ badzra shra ba ka tri shya dang*/ badzra pra tye ka hri shya dang*/ badzra kro dha tri shya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃḥ badzra sa twa nas/ badzra pra tye ka dang*/ badzra kro dha'i bar snying po lan gsum gsum dang*/ yang oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ nas/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa paṃ dang*/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥ'i sngags rnams dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ sgā ri sogs dang*/ rtsa sngags rnams lan gsum gsum so so la rim par sbyar nas brjod par bya'o/ /de nas/ lha thams cad kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa thog mtha' med pa'i chos nyid kyi ngo bos mtshan par gyur/ bar bsam mo/ /chos rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi lgog mar hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lce'i 'dab mar a las zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga la mchur nyal bas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badzra dzī ho/ so so'i phyag byas te/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bi da hūṃ/

zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥ'i bar lha rang rang gi sngags brjod cing*/ sems dpa' rnams la/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ri sogs dang*/ nyan rang khro bo rnams so so la rtsa sngags lan re brjod nas/ mthar rdo rje'i lte ba la lha rang rang gi sngags kyis mtshan par gyur bar bsam mo/ /las rgya ni/ gar dang glu dang ro dang zas/ /spyod lam la sogs bde ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni/ / las kyi phyag rgya dbang du gyur/ /so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ sarba bid lan lngaḥbadzra ghaṇḍa/ kalpa bha tra lan bzhi/ badzra shra wa ka /badzra pra tya ka /badzra kro dha'i bar rang rang gi mtshan sngags lan re brjod de/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur par bsam mo/ /phyag chen ni/ so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ sarba bid lan lnga nas/ badzra kro dha/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshon par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ /oṃ bud dha a bhi ṣāeñtsa oṃ/ nas/ oṃ karma bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ de nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarbā durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ a rha ta saṃ mya ka saṃ bud dha ya/ tatya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba bā baṃ bi sho dhā ne/ shud dhe bi shud dhe/ sarba karmāḥ.ā wa ra ṇā bi sho dha ne swā hā/ so so'i las rgya byas te/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇā bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ bstan pa lta bu'i skabs yin na/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces bya la tshe ldan gyi don du yin na/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces dang*/

gshin po'i don du yin na/ dmigs yul la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs skrags 'don pa dang myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces bya ba sbyar shing*/ 'phrin las 'di tshe ldan dang tshe 'das gang la'ang sbyar chog ste/ de dag yin yang 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar dgos pa dang 'tshang rgya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lha gzhan la'ang rim pa bzhin du rtsa sngags dang snying po dang 'phrin las gsum spel nas bya ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥshākya rigs dbang dang*/ oṃ sarba bid tra ṭa me tog cher rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs rnam pa bzhis kyang = oṃ na mo bha= oṃ bud dha lo tsa ne hūṃ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ oṃ badzra ma mā ka trāṃ rdo rje ma mā ki dang*/ oṃ badzra paṇḍa re de hi de hi sid dhi bo dhi lo ga trā ri bāṃ swā hā/ gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ badzra tā re tu ttā re tu re hūṃ hūṃ swa swa swa swā hā/ sgrol ma te yum rnam pa bzhis kyang = oṃ na mo= oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ oṃ badzra rā dzā dzaḥrdo rje rgyal po dang*/ oṃ badzra rā ga hoḥ rdo rje chags pa dang*/ oṃ badzra sā dhu dhū rdo rje legs pa te/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang = oṃ na mo= oṃ badzra ratna trāṃḥrdo rje rin chen dang*/ oṃ badzra te dzā rya rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ oṃ badzra ke tu bhri rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ oṃ badzra hā sa hā/ rdo rje bzhad pa te lho phyogs kyi= oṃ na mo= oṃ badzra dharmāḥhrīḥrdo rje chos dang*/ oṃ badzra tikṣā dhīḥrdo rje rnon po dang*/ oṃ badzra he tu kruṃ rdo rje rgyu dang*/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa bha rdo rje smra ba te/ nub phyogs kyi= oṃ na mo=

oṃ karmaḥkaṃ rdo rje las dang*/ oṃ badzra rakṣa raṃ rdo rje srung ba dang*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa kṣaṃ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ oṃ badzra sandhi ṣtaṃ rdo rje khu tshur te byang phyogs kyi= oṃ na mo= oṃ badzra lā sya hūṃ sgeg mo dang*/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ phreng ba ma dang*/ oṃ badzra gīrti hrīḥglu ma dang*/ oṃ badzra nri tye āḥgar ma te/ nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo bzhis kyang = oṃ na mo= oṃ badzra dhu pe hūṃ bdug pa ma dang*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ me tog ma dang*/ oṃ badzra a lo ke hrīḥmar me ma dang*/ oṃ badzra gandhe a dri chab ma ste/ phyi'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhis kyang = oṃ na mo= oṃ badzra a ku sha dzaḥrdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ rdo rje lcags sgrogs dang*/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥ rdo rje 'bebs pa ste nang gi sgo ba chen po bzhis kyang = oṃ na mo= byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros/ spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog /'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ dra ba can gyi 'od/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi bzad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun du bzang po te skal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang = oṃ na mo= dga' ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ rab 'byor/ 'char ka /ma 'gags pa/ kau di n+ya/ nye bar 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag/kun dga' bo/ ming chen/ nor sbyin 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung ste nyan thos chen po bcu drug gis kyang = oṃ na mo= gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ 'jigs pa med pa/ dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ ri bo rgyal/ smra ba'i sgra chen/ bse ru lta bu/ dug chen 'joms/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston/ seng ge sgra/ yid myur/ rang rgyal chen po bcu gnyis kyis kyang = oṃ na mo= khro bo bzhi/

bran bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngags pa bzhi/ khro bo chen po bcu drug gis kyang = mdzod cig /de nas bdag bskyed mchod pa sngar ltar bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te/ tshigs bcad gzhan nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yod ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshags pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ bā hyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gandhe/ ni wi tye pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /oṃ sarbā ta thā ga ta shapta pra tātstsha hūṃ swā hā/ sgeg sogs kyi mchod pas rgyas bsdus kyi dang po ni/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /oṃ badzra sa twa mū saṃ pra hā da/ badzra lā sya/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ oṃ badzra ratna mā nutta raṃ/ badzra mā ye/ rdo rje chos kyis glu blangs pas/ oṃ badzra dharmāḥgā ya ni/ badzra gīrti/ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra karmāḥg rod bhā we/ badzra nri tye/ de bzhin du/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa'= oṃ badzra satwa= badzra dha pe/ rdo rje rin chen oṃ badzra ratna= badzra puṣpe/ rdo rje chos kyi/ oṃ badzra dharmāḥ= badzra ā lo ke/ rdo rje las kun= oṃ badzra karmāḥ= badzra ghandhe/ zhes dang bsdu na/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ rdo rje rin chen= rdo rje chos= rdo rje las kun= oṃ badzra satwa su= badzra ratna= badzra dharmāḥ= badzra karmāḥ badzra yā sya/ badzra mā le/ badzra gīrti/ badzra nri tye/ badzra dhu pe/ badzra puṣpe/ badzra ā lo ke/ badzra ghandhe/ zhes bya'o de nas bstod pa ni/

mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung*/ /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don bsgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang*/

/tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang*/ khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yod mi 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgyas pa ste/ /lan cig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang*/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod/ rgyas par ni chos dbyings ye shes ma dang*/ bsdu na bstod pa gzhan gyis kyang rung*/ de nas/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka rang rang gi sa bon la bzlas pa'i sngags mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer can dang*/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra byung bar gyur/ oṃ sarbā bid sarbā ā wa raṇā bi shodha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarbā bid hūṃ/ oṃ sarbā bid phaṭa/ oṃ sarbā bid āḥ oṃ sarbā bid traṭa/ oṃ bud dha lo tsa ne hūṃ/ oṃ badzra ma mā kī trāṃ/ oṃ badzra paṇḍa re de hi de hi siddhiṃ bo dhi lo kottā ri bāṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra tā re tuttā re tu re hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swa swa swa swā hā/ oṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/ oṃ badzra dā dza dzaḥ oṃ badzra rā ga hoḥ oṃ badzra sā dhu dhu/ oṃ badzra ratna trāṃ/ oṃ badzra te dza rya/ oṃ badzra ke tu bhri/ oṃ badzra hā sa hā/ oṃ badzra dharmāḥhrīḥ oṃ badzra ti kṣ+ṇa ṇiḥ oṃ badzra he tu kruṃ/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa bha/ oṃ badzra karmāḥkaṃ /oṃ badzra rakṣaṃ ra/ oṃ badzra yakṣa kṣa/ oṃ badzra sandhiṣtaṃ/ oṃ badzra lā sya hū/ oṃ badzra mā le trāṃ/ oṃ badzra gīrti hrīḥ

oṃ badzra nri tya aḥ oṃ badzra bhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzra ganhe aḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra bā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍa hoḥ oṃ sarbā saṃ skā ri pa ri sho dhā na dharmāḥte ga ga nas mud ga te ma hā na ya pa ri wa re swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rtsa rig rnams ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya lan bdun nam gsum zla'o/ /de nas mchod pa bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā nas shapta pra tātstshi 'i bar gyis mchod de/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes bstod/ rgyas par byed na tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ bstod pa yang rgyas pa bya'o/ /de nas bum bskyed ni/ bum pa sta gon bya zhing*/ bum pa mang nyung gi khyad par 'byed dgos pa yod na'ang re zhig/bum pa las sngags kyis bsang*/ shūn+ya ta dang swa bhā lnga nas shuddho3haṃ/ bum pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ tapte ta pte ma hā ta pte swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṃ ga dang*/ bum pa'i chu dbyer med par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ pad zla'i gdan sum cu so bdun/ dbus kyi gdan la oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das kun rig sku mdog dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mda' ba/ phyogs bzhir pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ trām̐ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas padma hrīḥmatshan pa aḥ las sna tshogs rdo rje āḥmachod pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/

de bzhin gshegs pa bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po= lhor rgyal mchog rin chen= nub tu shākya rigs dbang = byang du me tog cher rgyas= de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi po yang rin po che'i= rgyab yol mnga' ba/ 'tshams bzhir pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ hūṃ las spyan gyis spras pa'i 'khor lo hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ trāṃ las rdo rje= hrīḥlas padma= aḥlas utpal= rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ yum bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo= lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo= nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo= byang shar du sgraun ma ljang khu brten pa/ shar gyi pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dzaḥlas lcags kyu= hoḥlas mda' gzhu= dhu las rdo rje rtse lnga pa= rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhir gyur pa ni/ gdan dang po la rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po= gdan gnyis pa la rdo rje rgyal po gser mdog= gdan gsum pa la rdo rje chags pa dmar po= gdan bzhi pa la rdo rje legs pa ljang khu/ lho'i pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ trāṃ las rin po che/ rya las nyi ma= bhi las rgya mtshan= hā las so 'phreng = lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhir gyur pa ni/ gdan dang po la rdo rje rin chen ser po= gdan gnyis pa la rdo rje gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdog can= gdan gsum pa la rdo rje rgyal mtshan sngon po= gdan bzhi pa la rdo rje bzhad pa dung dang = nub kyi pad zla'i gdan rnams= hrīḥlas padma= hrīḥlas ral gri= kruṃ las 'khor lo= dha las lce= nub phyogs kyi sems= gdan dang po la rdo rje chos dkar dmar= gdan gnyis pa la rdo rje rnon po sngon po= gdan gsum pa la rdo rje rgyu gser gyi mdog can= gdan bzhi pa la rdo rje smra ba zangs kyi mdog can= byang gi pad zla'i gdan rnams= kaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje= ra las go cha=

kṣaṃ las mche ba= ṣtam̐ las rdo rje= byang phyogs kyi= gdan dang po la rdo rje las zhal dang = gdan gnyis pa la rdo rje srung ba= gdan gsum pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po= gdan bzhi pa la rdo rje khu tshur ser po= nang gi 'tshams bzhir pad zla'i= hūṃ las rdo rje= trām̐ las rin po che'i phreng ba = hrīḥlas pi wang = aḥlas rdo rje rtse gsum pa= nang gi lha mo bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar lhor sgeg mo dkar mo= lho nub tu phreng ba ma ser mo= nub byang du glu ma dkar dmar= byang shar du gar ma= phyi'i 'tshams bzhir pad zla'i= hūṃ las spos snod= trāṃ las me tog gi snod= hrīḥlas mar me'i sdong bu = aḥlas dri'i dung phor= phyi'i lha mo bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar lhor bdug pa ma dkar mo= lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo= nub byang du mar me ma dkar dmar= byang shar du byug pa ma zhal dang byin pa/ phyogs bzhir pad zla'i gdan rnams= dzaḥlas lcags kyu= hūṃ las zhags pa= ba las lcags sgrog= hoḥlas rdo rje dril bu hoḥ sa mtshan pa rnams yongs su byung ba las/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa bzhir gyur pa ni= shar du rdo rje lcags kyu= lhor rdo rje zhags pa ser po= nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dkar dmar= byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po= g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ gtso bo'i g.yon du pad zla'i gdan la/ kṣaṃ las mche ba kṣa gis mtshan pa las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po/ lto ba yangs= bsdigs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ spyan ma nas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi bar gyi lha thams cad kyang rab tu dgyes pas spyan gdangs pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams can= zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ lha tshogs de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po= nas= bcom ldan 'das kun rig rtsa ba'i lha sum cu so bdun/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang = badzra sa ma dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/

ces pa nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ka ma la ya st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣbe āḥhūṃ/ ces pa nas/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra oṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes pa nas/ rakṣa ham̐/ oṃ pra wā ra sad ka ram̐ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarbā bid oṃ/ nas hūṃ/ dam rgya ni/ sa ma ya st+wam̐/ badzra ḍiṣti ma ṭa/ sarb+ba bid tri shya/ dzaḥ hūṃ ba hoḥ sa ma ya st+wa/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ gsum/ oṃ sarba bid/ sogs gsum re brjod pas gzhan rnams kyang sngar bdag bskyed du bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥ'e mjug tu/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra ḍīṣti ma ṭa/ badzra yakṣe traṃ shya/ dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya st+wam̐/ sa ma ya st+wam̐/ a ham̐/ badzra yakṣa/ gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ gsum brjod/ chos rgya dang las rgya dang phyag chen gsum gyi skabs su'ang sems dpa' nyan rang khro bo rnams kyi sngags dor nas/ badzra yakṣa/ brjod pa ma gtogs sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /oṃ bud dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sogs kyis dbang bskur nas/ 'phrin las bcol yang mi 'gal mod/ da lta phyag len du mi byed par snang bas bzhag /de nas mchod pa sngar ltar bsang sbyang bskyed de byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu bo gaṅgā ma'am/ chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes rang bzhin las/ sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo mchod yon ma/ bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas sgeg sogs brgyad kyis sngar bzhin mchod de/ bstod pa ni rgyud don gsal ba ltar na/ mnyam med mas bstod par snang la/ yang na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ bstod pa gzhan nam/ bde gshegs rigs lnga sogs saṃ/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ / phyag mtshal rnam par snang mdzad la/

/gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu/ /kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje skyod pa'i rlung*/ /bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi zad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ /zhes bstod cing*/ rang rang gi dam rgyas gzungs thag bzung la/ dung chos la/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūṃ/ brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun bzlas te/ dung chos kyi chu ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i lha rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las lha'i tshogs 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus nas rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarb+ba bid sarb+ba ā wa ra ṇā bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ sogs rnam rgyal bum pa la gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rnams kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig re/ las bum la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ thams cad la thun mong du/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti/ sogs rtsa rig brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i rjes su yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ oṃ sarb+ba bid sarb+ba ā wa ra ṇā bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ dang hūṃ/ lan bdun bzlas la dung chos kyis bum pa gnyis kar mchod yon ngang las thams cad pas me tog dkar po gsum gsum phul nas/

oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta puṣpe pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas/ shapta pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hās mchod la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ gis las bum gyi chu gtor te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams ma rdzogs pa de srid du bgegs rnams zlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ ces pa nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ zhes pa lta bu bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ gis bsang*/ shū n+ya dzñā na nas ko3haṃḥdang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ zhes sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ hrī las padma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje āḥs mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po sku mdog dkar po/ zhes sogs sla gdan gyi steng du rim par bskyed cing*/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus zhes sbyor ba ma gtogs/ phal cher bum bskyed kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar te/ 'on kyang 'dir/ shar gyi rtsibs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ zhes dang*/ lho'i rtsibs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor= nub kyi rtsibs bzhir= byang gi rtsibs bzhir= nang gi grwa bzhir dang*/

phyi'i grwa bzhir dang*/ nang gi sgo bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su/ zhes dang*/ rtsibs dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ zhes sbyor ba ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /de nas/ spyan ma nas 'bebs pa'i bar lha thams cad= rgyab yol mnga' ba/ rta babs dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi khyams kyi lha snam nang ma'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su kalpa bha dra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dang po'i rdo rje bzhi/ rdo rje rin po che bzhi/ rdo rje padma bzhi/ sna tshogs rdo rje bzhi ste phyag mtshan bcu drug /kalpa bha dra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pas mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug tu gyur pa ni/ shar du byams pa/ zhes sogs dang*/ lha snam par ma'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su shralpa ka'i ming yig= nyan thos bcu drug tu gyur pa ni/ shar du dga' bo/ sogs dang*/ lha snam phye ma'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su pra tye ka'i ming yig dang po thig les= rang rgyal bcu gnyis su gyur pa ni/ shar du gdung ba sel pa/ sogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi ma'i sgo bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su badzra kro dha'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa= rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan= 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bcu drug tu gyur pa ni/ shar sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang*/ zhes sogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar ro/ /phyi'i khor yug dkar po'i padma dang zla ba'i gdan rnams kyi steng du skad cig gis rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ gza' chen po brgyad rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa/ klu chen po brgyad rang 'dra'i chung ma dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed dgu chung ma dang bcas pa/

lha chen brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa stobs bzang la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa/ rdo rje phra men ma rnams dang*/ ri'i lha dang*/ shing gi lha dang*/ grong gi lha dang*/ 'byung ba'i bzhi'i lha la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gi sku mdog rgyan cha lugs sna tshogs dang bcas par gyur/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/

rang nyid hūṃ las hūṃ mdzad du gyur/ oṃ badzra da gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra bha sha ya hūṃ/ lan bzhi la sgo dbye/ lha tshogs de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ zhes pa nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ka ma la ya st+wam̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ nas badzra shapta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra aṃ gu sha dza ཿnas/ ghaṇḍa hoḥhūṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sandhi baṃ/ oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ oṃ pra wa ra sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ ces pa nas/ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ de nas dam rgya'i tshe/ sa ma ya st+wam̐/ badzra ḍi ṣti ma ṭa/ sarba bid tri shya/ sogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar la/ badzra krodha'i mjug tu/ badzra lo ka tri shya/ zhes dang*/ chos rgya'i skabs su rtsa rig brjod cing*/ las rgya dang phyag chen kyi skabs su/ badzra lo ka /zhes sbyar bar bya'o/ /'phrin las yang bdag bskyed ltar ram/ dmigs yul la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrig gnyis byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces bya zhing*/ nad pa sos dka' ba lta bu'i ched yin na 'phrin las 'di bzhin bya ba'am/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas na phan che'o/ /mgron thabs dang khor yug pa la 'phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ mtshan sngags mi brjod par snang yang ton na legs te/ gzhan rnams mtshan sngags brjod dgos pas so/ /'phrin las bcol ba'i tshe mjug tu/ phyi'i 'khor yug la gnas pa'i dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lngas kyang*/ zhes sbyor ba ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsang sbyang bskyed de byin gyis brlabs nas/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhes sogs sam/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba dgyes mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen mchod yon la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/ nam mkha' khyab par bsams shing dngos sprul nas/

/gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin 'khrigs gyur cig /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pratītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'di la tshig sbyor zur mi 'dra ba yod kyang 'dis chog /de nas sgeg sogs brgyad kyis sngar bzhin mchod nas/ mchod pa nyer lnga ni/ dpag med bsod nams stobs las byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas las grub rin chen cod paṇa mchog /snyan shal mdzes byed rin chen 'khyil ba'i rgyan/ /mgrin pa dung 'dra mdzes byed mgul gdub mchog /thugs mtshan dpal be'u mdzes byes se mo do/ /dpung pa mdzes byed dpung rgyan srung skud mchog /phyag gnyis khrig mar spras pa'i gdu bu mchog /dra bas 'grel pa'i sor mo'i gdu bu mchog /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i zhabs la mdzes byed rgyan/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta ratna mu ku ṭi bū dza sphā ra ṇa kham̐/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta ratna kunṭa lam̐/ ratna ha rga/ ratna a wa ha ra/ ratna ke yu ra= ratna pā ri ka ṭam̐ ka= ratna pa gam̐ wa la= ratna bā da bha ra nam̐= dpag med bsod nams = rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /mi mthun bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /snyan pa phyogs bcur g.yo ba'i ba dan 'phan/ /phyogs kun yid 'phrogs dar gyi ldi ldir spras/ /gdung sel rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ /rin chen rgyan 'od ldan pa'i bla re bres/ /rgyal ba= thugs rjes= oṃ sarb+ba= tstsha tram̐ ga pū dza sphā ra ṇa kham̐/ dhā tstsha gra= bā ta ka= pā ṭa dā ma= tsa ma ra= bi tā nam̐= dpag med= mi 'jigs bzhi ldan seng ge'i gdan la sogs/ / lha rdzas yid 'ong mdzes pa gzims cha'i tshogs/ /nyon mongs grwa zur spangs pa'i pho brang zlum/ /yon tan rgyas pa'i gru bzhi gzhal yas khang*/ /'jig rten las 'das gru bzhi nyis brtsegs khang*/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal byang sems zla ba'i gdan/ /rgyal ba= thugs rjes=

oṃ sarb+ba= sing ha a sa nam̐ pū dza sphā ra ṇa kham̐/ sha pa a sa nam̐= ba ri maṇḍal dhya n+ya= a ma ya tsa tur praḥ= dī ku ṭam̐ ga raṃ= tsand+ra a sa nam̐/ dpag med= 'dod pa'i 'dam gyi ma gos padma'i mchog /stong nyid sgra sgrogs pi wam̐ ting ting shag /thabs la mkhas pa zag med phung po'i dri/ /nyon mongs bkres sel chos kyi zhal zas mchog /ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa lha yi gos/ /rgyal ba= thugs rjes 'gro ba'i= oṃ sarb+ba= puṣpe pū dza sphā ra ṇa kham̐/ wi ni= gandhe/ nai w-i tya= wa st+ra= sarb+ba bid/ pū ra pū ra/ sū ra sū ra/ ā wa rta ya ā wa rta ya hoḥ de nas rgyal srid bdud ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ / 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog/ma ṇi= btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyud bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /st+ri= blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /pu ru ṣa= glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal te/ /bla med theg pa rab zhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ha sti=/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las yongs grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /tu ram̐ ga a shā/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyengs bral mchog ni thob par shogakha ḍa ga ratna/ zhes rgyal srid bdud phul/ de nas 'dod yon lnga ni/

kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ / bzhes shing bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta rū pa karmā gu na badzra pū dzi ti āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa/ /mos blos= bzhes shing = /oṃ sarb+ba= shapta= phyogs dus kun nas tsan dan sbrul snying dang*/ /a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos= /bzhes= gandhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems rtas byad ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos= /bzhes shing = /rā sa= phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen mkhril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos= /bzhes shing = /oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta sbarsha karmā gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ /zhes 'dod yon lnga phul/ de nas bstod pa rgyas pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar/ /sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag /gsung rab padma kha rgyas pa/ khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa yi/ /shākya'i rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes 'phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus par ni zhi mdzad pa/ /me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje las/ /rdo rje'i rigs rnams kun gyi yum/ /rdo rje sems mchog rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan ma la/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rdo rje las/

/rin chen rigs rnams kun gyi yum/ /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur mchog /= dbang nyi la/ /smon pa med pa'i rdo rje las/ /padma'i rigs rnams skyed mdzad pa/ /rdo rje padma gsang ba'i mchog /=dkar mo la/ /rdo rje mngon 'du mi byed las/ /las kyi rigs rnams skyed mdzad pa/ /rdo rje mchod la rab tu brtson/ /=sgrol ma la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*/ /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ / don yod rgyal ba rdo rje mchog /='gugs khyod la/ /rdo rje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /=gzhu khyod la/ /rdo rje legs pa sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che/ /rab dgyes rgyal po rdo rje mchog /=dgyes khyod la/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje don/ /rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che/ /nam mkha' snying po rdo rje phyug /=snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gzigs brjid cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ /='od khyod la/ /sems can don rab rdo rje dpal/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed/ /rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal/ /=dpal khyod la/ /rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /=rdo rje dga' ba la/ /rdo rje chos rab de nyid don/ /rdo rje padmo rab dga' byed/ /'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje'i sbyan/ /=rdo rje sbyan khyod la/ /rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /=blo khyod la/ /rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ / rab skor rdo rje las byung ba/ /=rdo rje snying po la/ /rdo rje gsung ba rab rig

mchog /rdo rje zlos pa rab sgrub sbyin/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchog grub pa/ /=rdo rje gsung khyod la/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rje dka'/ /las kyi rdo rje kun rab 'gro/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /=rdo rje kun khyod la/ /rdo rje srung ba brtan pa che/ /rdo rje cho ga sra ba che/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni thub par dka'/ /=rdo rje brtson 'grus la// rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi zad pa/ /=rdo rje drag po la/ /rdo rje 'tshams sbyor rab bsdus nyid/ /rdo rje 'ching bar rab grol byed/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /=rdo rje khu tshur la/ /rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma/ /mi dmigs rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje bsgyings ma la/ /rnam dag yon tan rdo rje ste/ /yid bzhin rdo rje re ba skong*/ /rdo rje gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma/ /=rdo rje 'phreng ba la/ /rnam dag rdo rje gsung mchog ma/ /rdo rje pi wang 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje gsung mchog sgrogs pa'i don/ /=rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la/ / rnam dag rdo rje las rab ster/ /las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad/ /bdud 'dul rdo rje phyag rgya can/ /=rdo rje gar mkhan la/ /sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma/ /tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pas/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /=rdo rje bdug pa la/ /rdo rje mdzes pa'i gzugs mdzes shing*/ /rdo rje me tog 'thor ba'i tshul/ /byang chub yan lag me tog ste/ /=rdo rje me tog la/ /'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /rdo rje spyan gyis ma rig sel/ /rdo rje gsal byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /=rdo rje snang byed la/ /rdo rje tsan dan bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rdo rje dri yis rnam rtog 'joms/ /rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /=rdo rje dri mchog la/ /rnam dag skul byed rdo rje'i don/

/rdo rje sdud mdzad rdo rje'i don/ /rdo rje 'gugs byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /=rdo rje lcags kyu la/ /mi gtong rdo rje chos kyi don/ /rdo rje 'dren pa mi 'gyur don/ /'ching mdzad rdo rje phyag rgya 'dzin/ /=rdo rje zhags pa la/ /rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bdag /rdo rje mgyogs byed klog bzhin myur/ /sgrol mdzad rdo rje phyag rgya 'dzin/ /=rdo rje lcags sgrogs la/ /rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag /skyong mdzad rdo rje kun gyi las/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/ /sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa'i rtags 'chad nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed 'khar sil po ti phyag /sbyangs stobs yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel don la brtan gnas pa'i/ /'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni/ /'byung dang ldog la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan pa/ /stag spags kyis ni rnam dkris shing*/ /'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal/ /phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar dang*/ /phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyid/ /zhes brjod/ de nas oṃ sarba bi da sogs kyi bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya brjod de/ dngos grub thams cad bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ sems can kun gyi don mdzod cig /ces brjod gsol ba gdab/ de nas cha gsum mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te/ badzra yakṣas/ bsang*/ hūṃ badzra a na las/ ga'i byin bskyed/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che zhes sogs kyis mchod pa sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma byin brlab ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuddhe dharmāḥte badzra sid dhe hūṃ/

na maḥsarb+ba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ bi ṣā mu khe bhyaḥ sarb+ba tad kham̐ ud ga te sba ra ṇa hi mam̐ ga ga na kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarb+ba dharmāḥṇam̐ a tya nu da pa na na twa da/ na maḥsarb+ba ta thā ga a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwā la tiṣṭha siddha lo tsa ni sarb+ba artha swa dha ni swā hā/ bdag gi bsam ba'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig /mgon po kun gshegs/ nas gshegs su gsol/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyel po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dgas srin po klu/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gdon gyi bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur bston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /spyan drangs/ oṃ e hye ti da sha di ka lo ka pā la sā pā ri wa ra sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ ru tra ge oṃ sha ta sa ha sra akṣi ye/ oṃ akṇe ye/ oṃ ya ma ye/ oṃ ni re te ye/ oṃ ba ru ṇa ye/ oṃ pā ya bai ye/ oṃ ku bai ra ye/ oṃ udmāṃ pra hma na ya/ su rya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsand+ran kṣa dra a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ adhā pri thi wi bhyaḥ a su ra bhya: nā ge bhyaḥs pā ri wa ra pra wā ra sad ka ram̐ argham̐ pra tī tstsha swā hā/ ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ oṃ ru tra ye/ ces pa nas/ nā ge bhyaḥs pā ri wa ra pra wā ra sad ka ram̐ argham̐ ces pa nas/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/

/me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i= mchod= gshin rje lag na be con 'chang*/ /ma mo rgyal po= lho phyogs gdon gyi/ mchod= bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po= lho nub gdon= mchod= /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po= /nub phyogs gdon phyi= /mchod= /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po= /nub byang gdon gyi= /mchod= gnod sbyin lag na dbyugs pa thogs/ /nor skyong gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs gdon gyi= /mchod= /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po= /byang shar gdon gyi= /mchod= /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod= /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod= 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ oṃ ru tra ye/ zhes pa nas/ nā ge bhyaḥs pā ri wa ra/ na maḥsarb+ba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ zhes sogs lan gsum brjod de 'bul/ shar phyogs rdo rje can de lha tshogs bcas/ /ces pa nas/ bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang phrags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan rnams med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/

/nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yogs 'khor tshogs bcas la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs byin/ / gsan nas phan bdag slad du 'dir sbyon cig /oṃ e hye hi yo ga kā ra ya/ de ba nā ga /yakṣa/ gan dha ra pa/ a su ra ga ru ḍa/ kinna ra ma ho ra ga /ma nu ṣa/ a ma nu ṣa/ sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ da ba zhes pa nas/ bra wa ra sad ka ram̐ arghaṃ ba tītstsha swā hā/ ka ma= oṃ de ba ces nas/ argham̐ nas bha pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ de ba ces pa nas sa pā ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ ces sogs gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*/ /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gang nas dang*/ /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu steng ka chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu sil ma can gang gnas dang*/ /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*/ /bka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag nas gang gnas dang*/ /lam srang sum mdo dang ni gzhi mdo dang*/ /gang dag lam chen dang ni shing gcig drung*/ /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*/ /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*/
