/bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de nas rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzad du gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= nam 'dir mchis par gyur/ oṃ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ gung ha ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ gung gung swā hā/ sarbā ri wa ra/ argham̐ pra tītstsha swā hā/ ka ma = oṃ gung ki raṃ/ nas sa pā'i slar argham̐ nas shapta pra titstsha swā hā/ oṃ gung ka ri nas sa pā ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha rjen za ba dang*/ /sems can rnams pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ljon shing gel ba sogs gnas pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po dang*/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phan chad bskyed par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ dul zhing yang dag bsdoms la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod par ma byed cig /oṃ chen po 'am chung ngu gang dag gi /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gi ci nus kyis/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gis 'dod pa bskang bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*/ /'dir ni che ge mo zhig gi /nad de nye bar sol mdzad la/ /gdon rnams rang gi gnas su dengs/ /sarba bi ghra na gatstsha/ bshegs 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /oṃ de gnas sad sha ra argham̐ pra tītstsha swā hā/ gatstsha/ sde brgyad 'khor bcas rang =

gyur/ oṃ ru tra ye/ zhes pa nas/ sad ka ram̐ argham̐ pra tītstsha/ gatstsha/ phyogs skyong 'khor 'gyur/ na maḥs manta bud dha nam̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ma wa lo ki ni oṃ sambha ra sambha ri hūṃ/ bdag gi bsam pa'i ces pa nas 'byung 'gyur cig/ de nas nye rig bshad pa bzhin byas nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis hūṃ mdzad sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stobs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ zhes sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril/ /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhi hi hi hi hi/ mgon po snyom pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzrod gha ṭa ces hūm̐/ oṃ sa ma ya pra pe shā ya mi/ oṃ pra nā mā mi sarba ta thā ga tam̐/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig /ces gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas dbang gi don du maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra rangṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gy-i shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/

zla ba/ rin po che'i gdug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i 'di ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol/ bshes nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ sa gzhi spos kyis byug shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnams dag zhing la spyod par shog /i daṃ gu ru ratna maṇḍal kaṃ niryā ta yā mi/ zhes phul la dka' chen khyab bdag ston pa po/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen pa'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ/ oṃ tsakṣu bandha ba ra ma na ye hūṃ/ āḥlaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ byang sdom ni/ dbang med bdag gis zhes pa nas yi rang ngo*/ /thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing*/ zhes pa nas/ mnyam med byang chub rnam par gzung bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa 'am/ /yang na yongs su bskyang bar bya phyir ram/

/rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di dag thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du btang*/ /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni/ /bdag dang gzhan rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig re re zhing yang bsdom par bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yi/ /chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ khyad 'phags gnas la bdag ni gnas par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ sngags sdom ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa ta lā mi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems kun rdzob pa de nyid snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid dang rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga ba'i rnam pa can du gyur ces nas sprad/ me tog bzung ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+wam̐/ hoḥsi da dhya/ badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha hūṃ/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa/ a sa me/ tri sa me/ ma hā sa ma ye hūṃ/ lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par byas so/ /rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de nas ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rnams kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur te/ 'di ni khyod kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin gyis/ gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na klad pa 'gas par 'gyur ro/

/rdo rje snying khar bzung ste/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /oṃ badzra u da ka ṭaḥs chu btung*/ rdo rje mgor bzung ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi sangs 'di gyis shis ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ /khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par shi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re zhes dam la bzhag /rang gi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar bo'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po'i lte bar āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badzrod gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be shā ya hūṃ/ lan gnyis/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar gnas pa'i rdo rje las ā byung ste rang gi snying khar gnas pa'i rdo rje'i dbus su gnas par gyur par bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /ye shes rdo rje bla med 'di/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /oṃ badzra pra be sha hūṃ/ badzra a pe sha a a/ zhes lan bdun nas brgya'i bar du brjod la ye shes dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hūṃ la sogs pa'i rnam par rang gi lus la thim par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya/ hri da ya mi/ pra pe sha dri ḍha tiṣṭha hūṃ/ sangs rgyas dngos su 'thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis/ /sman par dgongs nas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra pra ti grinha hūṃ/ me tog gtor/ oṃ badzra pra tītstsha sa ma ya st+waṃ/

sems dpa' stobs po che/ bdag byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rjes su gzung bar mdzod cig ces brjod/ de nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badzra hā sya ud ghā ṭa ya hūṃ med dang bsal/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi spyan phye bar gyur/ oṃ badzra pā shya ho/ zhes bya/ lhong ba bstan pa ni/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog /byang sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa/ phyi'i shar lhor bdug pa ma/ lho nub tu me tog ma/ nub byang du mar me ma/ byang shar du dri chab ma/ nang gi shar lhor sgeg mo ma/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma/ nub byang du glu ma/ byang shar du gar ma/ shar gyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rgyal po/ /gsum pa la rdo rje chags pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje legs pa/ lho'i rtsibs dang po la rdo rje rin chen/ gnyis pa la rdo rje gzi brjid/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bzhi pa la rdo rje bzhad pa/ nub kyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje chos/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rnon po/ /gsum pa la rdo rje rgyu/ bzhi pa la rdo rje smra ba/ byang gi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje las/ gnyis pa la rdo rje srung ba/ gsum pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin/ bzhi pa rdo rje khu tshur/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ /byang shar du sgrol ma/ shar du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ /lhor rgyal mchog rin chen/ nub tu shākya rigs dbang*/ byang du me tog cher rgyas/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa bdag nyid kyis mngon sum du mthong bar byung*/ dung chos kyi chu 'thung la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i

chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas nas gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni/ /bdun rgyud rigs ni brlag par mdzad/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyi/ /rgyal bas gsungs ba'i dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ /shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ / rdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams/ /dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*/ /sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang*/ /dus kun tu ni byang chub sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*/ /lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /sdig pa la sogs gang yin dang*/ /bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang*/ /de yi grib ma'ang 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs la de bzhin no/ /sngags dang lha la smad mi bya/ /gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min/ /mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ /mdor na yid gnyis sam̐ nyi the tshom mi bya ste/ /bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /de nas slob ma'i dbang la/ sa gzhi spos kyis zhes sogs kyis maṇḍal phul nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi shar du dbang rtags padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ /oṃ badzra sa twa sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhūpe/ a lo ke/ ganhe/ nai be tye/ tsha traṃ ga /dhātstsha gra/ shapta pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum na mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padmo rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/

/de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos dang mthun pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi zhing*/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /de nas chu dbang ni/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'dis/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa dag gyur te/ /byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /oṃ buddha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra=hūṃ/ oṃ ratna=trāṃḥ oṃ padma= hrī/ oṃ karmā ga la =āḥ oṃ sarb+ba =hūṃ phaṭa/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag nas byang chub kyi sems kyi byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur cig /dar rgyan gyi dbang ni/ so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis/ /skal ldan= /sku gsum thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ buddha=oṃ/ ratna=hūṃ/ padma=hrīḥ/ oṃ karmā=aḥ phreng ba'i dbang ni/ rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog phreng ba 'dis/ /skal ldan= /bsam pa myang 'das sbyor ba khams gsum gnas/ /mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ ratna ma ya a bha ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ cod pan gyi dbang ni/ mdzes shing yid 'ong dar gyi cod pan gyis/ /skal ldan= /shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa dang*/ / 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang dbang thob shog /oṃ ṭuṃ/ badzra pa ṭa a wa laṃ ba na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya'i dbang ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni/ /skal ldan= /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/

/ye shes lnga ni myur du rtogs par shog /oṃ badzra mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ buddha= oṃ/ oṃ ratna=trāṃ/ oṃ padma=hrīḥ oṃ karmā=āḥ yul lnga'i phyag rgya'i dbang ni/ yum lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas ni/ /skal ldan= /gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas su/ /'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ badzra dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ buddha=oṃ/ oṃ ratna=trāṃ/ oṃ padma=hrīḥ oṃ karmā=āḥ mig dbang ni/ kun rdzob mtshan nyid mtshan ma ming gi dbang*/ /skal ldan= /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'jig rten zhing khams su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog /oṃ badzra nā ma ma bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ buddha=oṃ/ oṃ ratna=trāṃ/ oṃ padma=hrīḥ oṃ karmā nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la'o/ /badzra lā sya/ nas badzra gandhe/ de nas slob dpon gyi dbang la maṇḍal phul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ba la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa la gnas pa'i seng ge'i khri'i steng du/ padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa pā ri wa ra puṣpe nas tstsha traṃ ga /dhātstsha gra/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs kyis shis pa brjod la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /zhes nas/ dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes rdo rje byin/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzang*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /der bu byin la/ srid pa ngo bo nas bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i rgyal ba'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni gsang ba'i rdo rje yin la/

de dran pa'i don du rdo rje bzung snyam pa dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i sgra dril bus sgrog par sems dpa'i rdo rje dril gyi de kho na nyid dran pa'i sgo nas bzung zhig /rdo sems kyi phyag chen 'chings la/ rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal bar dmigs pa la brten nas pradzñā u pa sogs kyi don dang thabs shes rab dbyer med kyi zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo rgyud la skyes par gyur zhes brda sprad/ oṃ pradzñā u pas ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ aḥ rdo rje rgya gram lag tu sbyin nas ni/ /skal ldan= /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro don mthar phyin te/ /las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ oṃ badzra karmā a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ yon tan rab rdzogs gser gyi 'khor lo 'dis/ /skal ldan= /rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog rab thob ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo myur du bskor bar shog /bhruṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ /zhes 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ badzra tsakra a dhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ bhruṃ/ dbyangs yig tha ma aḥ las byung ba'i dung*/ zhes dung dang*/ oṃ badzra bha ṣa raṃ/ dbyangs yig dang po aḥlas byung ba'i sbyong rgyud kyi po ti/ zhes po ti dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos dung bla na med/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /dbyangs yig tha ma aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ /zhes dril bu rnams bzung*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog ni mnyam nyid gsal/ /zhes brjod/ rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang ni/ rigs lnga'i bdag po yi ni rang bzhin gyis/ /skal ldan= /rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por shog

/'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes rdo rje dang*/ oṃ badzra tsakra a dha pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ 'jig rten= /sems can= /ji ltar sna= /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /'khor lo dang*/ oṃ budha tsakra = oṃ oṃ oṃ/ 'jig= / sems= /ji= /rin chen= /zhes rin po che dang*/ oṃ ratna= trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /zhes pa nas/ padma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /padma dang*/ oṃ padma nas hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ 'jig rten kun la zhes pa nas las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ sna tshogs rdo rje rnams gtad pa'aṃ bzung ngam phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ karmā nas ṣiñtsa aḥ.aḥ.aḥ gsang dbang ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar bcings nas ni/ skal ldan= ye shes lnga yi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /byang sems gsang ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu hya a bi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra nas hūṃ/ oṃ ratna nas trāṃ/ oṃ padma nas hrīḥ.oṃ karmā nas a: zhes brjod de/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar gzhag go /gu hya zhes pa gsang ba'i don ni dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid slob dpon gyi las rnams yin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid ni/ tshad med bzhi'i tshul gyis gnod sems la sogs pa mi mnyam pa med pas gru bzhi/ dran pa la sogs pa'i dbang po lngas thar pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pas sgo bzhi/ bsam gtan bzhis rta babs bzhi/ sems can gyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pas gos dang gdugs la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan/ nang gi ling tshe brgyad ni rnam thar brgyad/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i mdo sde'i chos 'khor gdul bya'i rgyud la skye bar mdzad pa ni rdo rje phreng bas yongs su bskor ba la sogs pa yin la/ lha'i de nyid ni chos dbyings ye shes dang*/

me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes lnga ni rim pa bzhin rnam snang la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzhi ni spyan ma la sogs pa'i yum bzhi/ nang dang*/ phyi dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ chen po stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang gi mig sogs bzhi la mngon zhen spangs pa'i cha bzhi/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dang*/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang*/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes sogs bzhi la mngon zhen spangs pa'i cha bzhi/ rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa lho phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang*/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ sems can mtha' yas pa'i don byed pa sogs bzhi la bden zhen spangs pa'i cha bzhi/ rdo rje chos la sogs pa nub phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ gzugs sku'i mtshan dpe sogs bzhi la mngon zhen spangs pa'i cha bzhi/ rdo rje las la sogs pa byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ sbyin pa nas sher phyin gyi bar drug dang*/ smon lam dang thabs kyi phar phyin rnams kyi mi mthun phyogs ser sna nas thabs la mkhas pa'i bar spangs pa'i cha brgyad ni sgeg mo nas dri chab ma'i bar brgyad/ dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ dran pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun phyogs ma dad pa la sogs pa spangs pa'i cha bzhi ni rim pa bzhin rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa sgo ba bzhi/

nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa stong nyid bcu drug rtogs pa'i cha bcu drug ni/ byams pa la sogs pa bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug skye/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid rten dang brten pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor sna tshogs par shar ba yin la/ slob dpon gyi las kyi rim pa ni/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs pa rnams yin no zhes dkyil 'khor kho na nyid bstan/ de nas/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud dang mnyam bzang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ dus gsum rgyal bas bskor ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /mi khom rgyun gcod rgyu dang 'bras bu ston/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug rin po che/ /bla med 'khor lo dam pa bsgor gyur cig /ces 'khor lo dang*/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūrya/ kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*/ /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan rin po che/ /'khor ba'i mun sel bde ba'i snying po 'byung*/ /dgos pa mchog sbyin nor bdun phun sum tshogs/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen spyod par shog zhes gong bu dang*/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /lpags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ / btsun mo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ st+rī ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ pha rol phyin bcus sems can skyob pa'i phyir/ /shes rab gzugs mdzes btsun mo rin po che/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi tshad med bzhi po yi/ /tshe dang longs spyod gter la spyod par shog

/zhes btsun mo dang*/ gang yang rgyal la mu tig mdangs ldan pas/ /gser sogs mang po thugs la phul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan te/ /blon po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ pu ru ṣa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ gang la ci dgos dpag bsam shing lta bur/ /'gro la snying brtses tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ /dbang phyug btsun pa blon po rin po che/ /'khor los sbyar ba'i rgyal tshab thob par shog /ces blon po dang*/ yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ha stī ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ theg pa don dam bla na med pa'i mchog /yan lag bdun mdzes ku mu ta yi mdog /gdul dka' stobs chen glang po rin po che/ khyu mchog rlabs chen stobs lnga rdzogs par shog /ces glang po dang*/ tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog 'gyur ba/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tu raṃ ga a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ 'khor ba'i chu bo 'jigs pa bzhi las sgrol/

/brtson 'grus myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis skyod/ /cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rin po che/ /mi gnas ye shes yid bzhin spyod par shog /ces rta mchog dang*/ 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur ba'i/ /bdud dpung ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag mi rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ khaṅga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ gnod pa'i dpung 'joms brtson 'grus go bgos shing*/ /'jigs pa'i skyabs byed 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dmag dpon 'dis/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung gis srung bar shog /ces dmag dpon gyi dbang blang ngo*/ /de rnams kyang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen sna bdun gyi sgo nas rang gi rgyal srid la mnga' bsgyur ba bzhin du/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bas rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab du byas pa'i slob ma yang rin chen sna bdun dang 'dra ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs kyis chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' bsgyur ba'i don du rin chen sna bdun gyis dbang bskur ba byas pa yin no/ /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang*/ /srog chags rnams ni gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /brdzun du smra bar bya ba min/ /pha rol bud med spyad mi bya/ /bla ma smad par mi bya ste/ /de yi grib ma mi 'gom zhing*/ /slob dpon ma yin mi gzung la/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshan mi gzung*/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mi smod de/ /lha rnams la yang smos ci dgos/ /ci ste glen pas smad na ni/ /nad kyis nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rnying dang lha yi grib ma dang*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /phyag rgya yi ge mtshan ma rnams/ /gom pas 'gom par mi bya'o/ /de bas dkon mchog gsum dag dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang*/ /bla ma smod la brtson pa rnams/

/mkhas pas bsgrims te bsgrub par bya/ /chos mi ldan dang sdig spyod dang*/ /rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang*/ /dam tshig sdang rnams snying brtse ba'i/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni sngags kyis bsgrub/ /'jungs pa rnams kyi nor blangs la/ /sems can phongs la sbyin par bya/ /bla ma la ni mchod pa dang*/ /de ltar dam tshig bsgrub pa dang*/ /dkyil 'khor phyir dang dam tshig can/ /phan phyir rgyal ba'i sras rnams la/ /mchod phyir mi yi dbang po 'am/ /phyug po rnams kyi nor dprog go /sems can rnams la phan spyod pas/ /rtag tu dam tshig bla ma'i nor/ /srog chags srog ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /brdzun du yang ni smra bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes bya dang*/ /dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung bar bya/ /sngags rig pas ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad byas shing kun zos kyang*/ /'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes dam tshig dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā dzñā te dā sya mi grihna badzra su siddha ye/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha hūṃ/ bka'i dbang bskur/ maṇḍal phul te/ de nas tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang*/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na/ /lha mi'i bde ba smos ci dgos/ /sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni/ / rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur bas/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang*/ /rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya/ /rtag tu 'khor dang gcugs mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la/ /bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /bla ma smod brtson ma rung dang*/ /dam tshig las ni 'da' ba dang*/ /de sogs byed pa tshar gcod na/ /'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsung*/ /sems can kun la snying brtser chags/

/bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dbang bskur na/ oṃ badzra dha ra/ ratna dha ra/ padma dha ra/ bi shwa dha ra ta thā ga tā sa ma ya mā ti kra ma ti ta thā ga ta dhā ra sa ma ko3haṃ/ zhes dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnam snang chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog / zhes brjod do/ /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga'i zur 'debs tshe 'das rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ ming byang la sogs pa mdun du bzhag la/ las bum gyi chu dang las thams cad pas bsangs te/ oṃ shūn+ya tā nas haṃ/ rten snang ba mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe 'das kyi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe las 'das pa tha mal pa'i cha byad can/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings te/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ dzdza: sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad dang*/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa srid pa bar ro/ khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug /skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang na gnas kyang*/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas/ thugs kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba a thung gi gzugs can bkug ste/

spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying khar thim/ oṃ shodha ne shodha ne sarb+ba pā paṃ a dha a hūṃ/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad kyang bkug par gyur par bsams la/ ltung ba slaung ba'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ sarb+ba a pā ya ā karṣa na bi shodha ne badzra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ngan 'gro ba thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bkug par gyur par bsams la/ de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di las bskyob tu gsol/ bdag cag sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang khyod la yang skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la sdig pa 'joms pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi bi spho ṭa ya sarb+ba a pā ya bandha nā ni pra mo kṣa ya sarb+ba a pā ya ga te bhyaḥ sarba sa twa naṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa ma ya tra ṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad bcom zhing shi nas rnam snang gi zhabs drung du skyes/ /rten rnams pa tsha can gyi rgya mtshor dor bar gyur par bsams pa'i bar 'di rnams kyang bya'o/ /oṃ sarb+ba bad sarb+ba a pa ya bi sho dha ne hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ badzra bandha traṭa/ ces brjod cing rdo rje bsdams pa lan gsum dral/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs par gyur bar bsams la/ a sarb+ba bid oṃ/ zhes sogs kyis sngar ltar 'jig rten gsum rgyas kyi skabs ltar gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnas nyer gnyis su gtud cing*/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha dzñā na sa ma ye hūṃ zhes brjod/ tshe ldan la skabs 'di nas byed cing*/ de nas bgegs sbyang ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par zhes pa nas gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza zhes sogs kyis khro bo spyan drangs nas mchod bstod sngar ltar byas la/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarb+ba bighāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo/ zhes sogs gsum gyis bgegs la bsngo zhing zhi bas sbyang*/

til lo mar me dang chang bu bcas rten la phyir skor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ/ grihna grihna hūṃ/ grihnā pa ya grihnā pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wā na badzra hūṃ? phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing zhi drag byed mas sbyang*/ de nas sngar bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ tshe 'phos nas gang du gnas pa'i lus srog dang mtho ris dang thar pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad dang*/ tshe las 'das pa'i cha byad bzung nas/ de'i nye 'brel dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la bslu zhing gnod par byed pa'i gnod sbyin dang sha zas dang 'byung po la sogs pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa thams cad spangs la/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su song shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis sreg cing rnam par 'joms par gdan mi za'o/ /zhes dang*/ sumbha ni'i sngags drag tu brjod de drag pos sbyang ngo*/ /de nas me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing zhal gdangs par skad cig gis grub par bsam pa 'am/ yang na hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bskyed la/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/

khyed rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi nas shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra ṭā ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ = rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal/ /tshe 'das kyi rkang mthil gnyis su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus par gyur/ lte ba'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis snying kha'i paṃ ded nas sna sgo nas 'thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas rang gi lag par bzung ba'i til la thim par bsams la/ oṃ badzra ḍū ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smi ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing til 'bul ba ni sbyin bsreg gis sbyar ba'o/ /de nas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka na/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba sa twa nā ñtsa swā hā/ zhes mi 'jug pa'i gzungs dang*/ oṃ na ma stāai ya dhi kā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya garbhe dzwa la dzwa la/ dharmā dhā tu garbhe/ saṃ bha ri ma ma ā yuḥsaṃ shodha ya ma ma sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa mante ṣṇāo ṣe bi ma le bi shuddhe hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ aṃ baṃ saṃ dzaṃḥswā hā/ zhes gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs dang*/ oṃ padmo ṣṇī gā ra bi ma me hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ 'grub na/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba tri lo kya pra ti bi shiṣta ya/ buddhā ya te na maḥtadya thā/ oṃ bhruṃ bhruṃ bhruṃ/ shodha ya shodha ya/ bi shodha ya bi shodha ya/ a sa ma ya manta a ba bhā sa spha ra ṇa ga ti/

ga ga na swa bha ba bi shud dhe/ a bhi ṣiñtsa ntu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tāḥ su ga ta bar pa tsa na a mṛ ta a bhi ṣe kai ra/ ma hā mu drā mant+ra pa daiḥ ā ha ra a ha ra/ ma ma a yussaṃ dhā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā ba bi shuddhe/ uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya ba ri shuddhe/ sa ha sra rasmi sañtso de he/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ni/ ṣa ṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta mā te/ da sha bhā mi pra tiṣṭha te/ sarba ta thā ga tā hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭha te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ badzra kā ya saṃ ha ta na pa ri shuddhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shuddhe/ pra ti ni warta ya ma ma ā yur/ bi shuddhe sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma ya a dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭhi te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni/ bu mu ni bu mu ni ma hā bu mu ni/ ma ti ma ti ma hā ma ti/ ma ma ti su ma ti ta thā tā/ bhū ta ko ṭi ba ri shuddhe/ be sphu ṭi buddhe shuddhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ spha ra spha ra/ sphā ra ya sphā ra ya/ sarba buddha a dhiṣṭha na ya dhiṣṭhi te/ shuddhe shuddhe/ buddhe buddhe/ badzre badzre ma hā badzre/ su badzre badzre garbhe dza ya garbhe/ bi dza ya garbhe/ badzra swa lā garbhe/ badzrod bha be/ badzra sa bha be/ badzra ba dzri ni/ badzra mbha ba tu ma ma sha rī raṃ/ sarba ta twa nā ñtsa kā ya pa ri shuddhe bha ba tu/ mes dā sarba ga ti ba ri shuddhe shtsa/ sarba ta thā ga tā shtsa/ māṃ sa mā shwā sa yantu/ budhya budhya/ si dhya si dhya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ pi po bha ya pi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi shodha ya bi shodha ya/ sa manta na mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ sa mantar smi ba ri shuddhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhā te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ ma hā mu drā mant+ra ba daiḥswā hā/ oṃ bhruṃ swā hā/

oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ zhes pa rnam par rgyal ba'i gzungs dang*/ lha rnams kyi sngags kyang gong du'am 'dir bzla'o/ /gzhan yang sngags ci rigs bzlas nas mthar yig brgya brjod de/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi shodha na badzra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karmā ā wa ra ṇā ni bha smī ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhrum̐ bi nā sha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi shodha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ ha ra ha ra sarba a wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni spho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bri ta bri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tshindha tshindha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga ti he tuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga ti he tuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba ti dya ka ga ti hai tuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing rten la zab/ sngags don dang mthun pa'i dmigs pa dang spel tshig bya ba ni zab pa'i sgo nas sbyang ba'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang ras bris sogs kyi sku gzugs me long du shar ba la/ thus gsol la cung zad rgyas pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes sogs dang*/ mkhyen pas srid pa'i sogs dang*/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i sku= rgyal ba'i gsung = rgyal ba'i thugs= rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sogs dang*/ de dag sku la sogs brjo/ zla med ston pa de yi sogs dang*/ byams pa thogs med sogs sam/ klu sgrub ārya de ba sogs dang*/ thub pa'i bstan la sogs dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag sogs dang*/ gangs can shing rta'i sogs dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa sogs dang*/

dge legs yon tan sogs dang*/ blo bzang rgyal ba sogs dang*/ blo gros yangs pa'i sogs dang*/ zab mo lta ba'am/ rab 'byams gsung rab 'am/ gang gis bdag la sogs dang*/ de dag sku la sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs dang*/ mtshan legs rin chen sogs dang*/ mthun pa'i smon lam sogs dang*/ mar me mdzad sogs sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro la sogs dang*/ kun 'byung mun pa'i sogs dang*/ smra bsam brjod med sogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na'am/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang skyabs grol sogs dang*/ spangs dang ye shes sogs dang*/ don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ ston pa sangs rgyas rnams la sogs dang*/ de dag sku sogs dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun rigs sogs sam/ bde gshegs rigs lnga rgyal ba sogs dang*/ bskal ba bzang po'i lam/ yang na sgo yi khyams na sogs dang*/ ston pa'i rtags sogs dang*/ rten 'brel don la sogs dang*/ dpal ldan dus 'khor ram/ sgrub pa po la sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i lhan skyes sogs dang*/ ye shes mgon po sogs sam/ dam can sgrub pa po 'am/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru sogs dang*/ de dag sku sogs dang*/ khyed sku rang bzhin sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sogs dang*/ 'gro ba nyon mongs sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus chab sogs dang*/ de dag sku la sogs dang*/ srab 'jam yang ba sogs brjod cing lha la khrus bya la/ bsdu na de dag las bsdus te ji ltar rigs par brjod/ grangs mang po dgos pa yin na bar pa rnams la lha la khrus ma byas kyang rung zhing*/ phyin drug po sogs ste tshan so so'i mthar sngags spel tshig dang sbyar nas khrus bya'o/ /khrus gsol ba'i chu bum par blugs te/ gang zag gam ro yin na dngos su dang*/ ming byang yin na dngos su 'am/ yang na nub gong ma rnams la gzugs brnyan shar ba dang tha mal dngos su bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/

/btung ba dri yis legs bsgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la khrus bya'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes sogs rtsa rigs brjod pa'i rjes su tshe ldan yin na/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i 'phrin las dang*/ tshe 'das yin na/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /tshe ldan len na'ang grub na/ skabs 'dir sngags spel tshigs dang bcas rgyal bar byas na legs/ sbyin pa zhes pa'i gnas su tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab zhes dang ser sna zhes pa'i gnas tshul 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal dang*/ srung ba byas pa bstan pa ting 'dzin ye shes bzhi sbyong*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ / gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas las/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ /rgya tshan yon tan drug ldan pa/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga zhes so/ /tshigs bcad de dang rtsa rigs spel ba'i mthar/ 'jig rten 'di nas zhes pa nas khyad par du yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun phyogs byang zhing dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/

/de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'/ /dam chos gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags= /de dag= /bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga'/ /dge 'dun gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /oṃ na mo zhes sogs dang*/ 'jig rten 'di nas zhes pa nas khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i dbang gis byung ba'i dug thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du zhes spel tshig sbyar ro/ /sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ bden pa'i bden tshig de dag gis/ che ge'i dug ni dug med shog /dug ni sa yi nang du song*/ gang ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ chu ni dug gi ma yin te/ zhes pa nas gsher ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ me ni dug gi ma yin te/ /zhes pa nas tsha ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ rlung ni dug gi ma yin te/ zhes pa nas/ g.yo ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ oṃ na mo zhes sogs dang*/ 'jig rten= khyad par du yang 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur ba'i dug thams cad = gyur cig /rgyas par byed na de rnams so sor bya ste/ khrus kyis sbyang ba'o/ /de nas gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing*/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ / thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*/ /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la=/ ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la= /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la= / gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cig/gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la= /gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing 'khru ba mi mnga' ba/ /gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/

khyed la= /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cig /don grub chos kyang grub pa des/ khyed la= /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*/ /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ khyed la= /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la= /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la= /yid 'phrog gang gis mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad de/ /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la= / sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*/ / 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis bsams pa yis/ khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs gyur/ /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs gyur/ khyed cag lam bgrod bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ khyed cag sdig pa ma gyur cig /che ge mo zhes bya ba bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /ces pa ni mi shes pa sbyang ba'o/ /grangs mang po dgos pa yin na/ bar pa rnams la bkra shis bsdus pa gzhan brjod cing*/ phyag 'tshal yang bsdus pa 'am med kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas tshe 'das de nyid bsam pa thag pas dkon mchog gsum dang nye ba'i sras brgyad la skyabs su 'gro zhing phyag byed par bsams la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ /de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi/

/de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*/ /de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas/ /kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'jug /'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis/ /bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*/ /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig can bdag la skyob tu gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje che mgon thams cad la/ /skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byed byed pa'i/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /tshe ldan yid na 'di nas shis brjod mdor bsdus byas pa 'grub bo/ /de na tshe 'das lhar bskyed pa ni/ bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las rten padma dang zla ba'i zhes pa nas 'dzin par gyur ba'am/ 'dir ye shes pa 'gug gzhug byas na 'brel zhing*/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa pa ra wa ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la/ zhes bstod/ de nas zas gtad byed na/ bsangs te gzi byin bskyed la sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra nas spha ra ṇa baṃ/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs te/ kha dog dbyibs= /phyogs dus= /mos blos rten bskyed lha la'am/

mchod nas lha la bdag 'bul na/ bzhes shing bla med byang chub brnyes gyur cig gam/ brnyes par mdzod/ ces brjod de 'bul/ de nas dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ / mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ ratne ratne/ ma hā ratne/ ratna sambha we/ ratna ki ra ṇe/ ratna mā lā bi shudha/ shodha ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bam bstan pa/ padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ /srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /srid pa'i padma las 'byung ba/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ padme padme padmas sambha wa/ ma hā su khā ba ti ga tstsha na tu swā hā/ me tog gtor ming sbyangs pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes dang lha ye shes pa dbyer med du 'dres pa spyi gtsug nas thon te/ bde ba can du gshegs pas der padma las brdzus te skyes nas de na gnas pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis/ mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med de/ /sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /ces mchod du brjod par bsam de yang bdag gis cho ga byas pa'i nus mthur shes nas skad cig gis tshangs te/ e ma'o shākya mgon po yi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi/ /sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /sngags kyi yon tan sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /byang chub brten pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab/ /tshangs spyod tshul khrims dri med skyes bsam yas/

/e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir mtshams med lhung ba yi/ /sems can lha gnas myur du skyes/ /slar yang bde ba can du gshegs par gyur/ /oṃ sarba bud dha kṣāe tra gatstsha na du swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor/ de nas smon lam mdor bsdus gdab cing*/ gtang rag gi mchod pa bsang sbyang sogs byas nas/ tshigs bcad gzhan nas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yin 'di/ / bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar dang*/ sgeg sogs brgyad kyis sngar bzhin mchod/ bde gshegs rigs lnga 'am rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun rig rnam snang*/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ /shākya rigs dbang me tog cher rgyas sogs/ /rigs lnga yul bzhi rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ /sgeg mo la sogs mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad/ /lcags kyu la sogs sgo ba rnams pa bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la= /bskal ba bzang po'i sems dpa' bcu drug dang*/ /nyan thos bcu drug rang rgyal bcu gnyis po/ /sgo srung khro bo chen po bcu drug ste/ /mgron thabs drug cu'i lha la= /phyi yi 'khor yug nas kun bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa'am/ bstod pa brgyad pa sogs ci rigs kyis bstod cing*/ yig brgya bzlas pa nas/ me tog dang bcas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir yul can skyob pa'i phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis par/ / 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzod rigs/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*/ /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*/ /bdag gis brjed ngas ci mchis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/

mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ khyad par du yang 'gro ba dmigs yul gyis gtso byas sems can thams cad tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang nas gyur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /skye ba thams cad du 'ang sngags 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i rten sha stag thob pa dang*/ gnas skabs su bdag cag las dang po bsams bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad kyi nyes ltung tshogs ci mchis par gyur pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod rnams kyis thugs bzod par bzhes la/ bdag cag rnams kyi tshe 'di la bar chad dang phyi ma la sdig pa dang sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod pa'i/ /dngos grub bla na med pa stsol/ /oṃ sarba bid nas hūṃ phaṭa/ mdun bskyed kyi spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi bris sku'i rten 'di nyid la thim zhing*/

ji srid 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ nas gzir las dgrol/ oṃ pra wa ra sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rdul tshon gshegs gso ba yin na/ sarba bid ces sogs rang rang gi snying po lan gsum gsum bzla zhing*/ badzra muḥzhes dang*/ badzra muḥzhes bya zhing*/ rta mchog min na gshegs gsol bsgrub pa mchog ste/ de yang oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra sa twa/ badzra muḥ bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsdus te rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid aḥ oṃ sarba bid hūṃ/ badzra karmā kaṃ /badzra rakṣa raṃ/ badzra yakṣa kṣaṃ/ badzraṃ sandhi ṣtaṃ/ oṃ badzra sa twa uṣti ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs byung ste rang gi spyi bor gtsug tor gyi tshul du gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ bla brgyud smon lam shis brjod rnams logs su 'byung ba ltar la/ bsdu na/ bla brgyud ni/ ma no buddha bai ro tsa na ye/ khyab bdag chen po rnam snang mdzad/ /dgra las rnam rgyal kun dga' snying*/ /rab 'byor bskyangs dang na ya kar/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /mai tri pa dang rdo rje gdan/ /nis ka laṃ ka wa ranta/ /chag lo g.yag ste legs pa'i blor/ /gsol= /dpal ldan seng ge bu ston zhabs/ khyad lhas rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /'dul 'dzin la sogs bla ma la/

/gsol ba= /de ltar gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /skye kun rjes bzung ngan song las/ /des thar dal ba'i rten rnyed nas/ /bla med byang chub thob gyur cig /bstod pa ni/ rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dngos/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dkyil 'khor gtso/ /zhal bzhi phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag can/ /rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes bzhi yi dngos/ /sbyor rgyal la sogs rigs bzhi yi/ / bde gshegs rnams la= /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi yi/ /ting nge 'dzin bzhi rnam dag cing*/ /rigs bzhi'i yum gyur spyan la sogs/ /lha mo bzhi la phyag= / nang dang phyi dang gnyis ka dang*/ /chen po stong pa'i ting 'dzin dngos/ /rdor sems la sogs shar phyogs kyi/ /sems dpa' rnams la phyag= /stong nyid don dam 'dus byas dang*/ /'dus ma byas kyi ting 'dzin dngos/ /rin chen la sogs lho phyogs kyi/ /sems dpa' rnams la phyag= /mtha' 'das thog tha dor ba med/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i ting 'dzin dngos/ /rdo rje chos sogs nub phyogs kyi/ /sems dpa' rnams la phyag= /rang mtshan dngos po dngos med dang*/ /ngo bo stong pa'i ting 'dzin dngos/ /rdo rje las sogs byang phyogs kyi/ /sems dpa' rnams la phyag= /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa'i dngos/ /rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa/ /nang gi lha mo bzhir phyag 'tshal/ /bsam gtan shes rab smon lam dang*/ /thabs kyi pha rol phyin pa'i dngos/ /rdo rje bdug pa ma la sogs/ /phyi yi lha mo bzhir phyag 'tshal/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin bzhi dag pa'i dngos/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcag sgrog dang*/ /dril bu rnams la phyag= /nang stong nyid la sogs pa yi/ /stong nyid bcu drug rtogs pa'i cha/ /byams pa la sogs bskal bzang gi /sems dpa' rnams la= /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyi/ /bslab gsum la gnas sbyangs stobs ldan/

/thos pa'i pha rol phyin gyur pa/ /nyan thos rnams la= /zab mo rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi/ /lugs 'byung ldog la goms pa yis/ /rang byung ye shes mngon mdzad pa'i/ /rang rgyal rnams la= /thugs mchog zhi las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug pa tshar gcod khros pa'i sku/ /bdud dang gdon bgegs 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / smon lam ni/ de ltar thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ mchod bstod bzlas dang bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor sogs/ legs par bsgrubs pa'i rnam dkar phung po yis/ /'gro kun srid zhi'i 'jigs las grol gyur cig / dam chos sgrub pa'i dal ba'i rten rnyed nas/ /theg pa mchog gi mgon gyis rjes bzung ste/ /dkar nag las dang de rgyu phra rags la/ /'jug ldog tshul bzhin byed pa nyid gyur cig /'khor ba'i ngang tshul me 'obs ltar mthong nas/ /nges 'byung blo shugs drag po rab skye zhing*/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de/ /phyin drug rlabs chen spyod la 'jug par shog /de nas rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srung ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kun la thos bsam gyis/ /zhugs nas zab lam sgrub pa nyid gyur cig/lce lag byin gyis brlabs pas lus ngag gi /phyag rgya'i rig byed mthu chen ldan pa dang*/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal rnal 'byor mchog sogs kyis/ /bgegs rnams tshar gcod srung bar byed par shog /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor gyi/ /zhing la dmigs pa'i bsod nams tshogs bsags te/ / lag sor thabs shes ngo bor byin brlabs pas/ /phyag rgya 'ching dang dgrol la dbang bar shog /ma dag snod sbyong gzhal yas khang bsgoms pa/ /der ni rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mtshon pa'i/ /cho ga gsum gyi sbyor bas rnam snang gi /dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin rdzogs gyur cig /rigs kun bdag po'i thugs kar zla gdan steng*/

/rang rang sa bon phyag mtshan sku rdzogs pa'i/ /spro bsdu'i rim pas rigs lnga yab yum sogs/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /tha mal lus ngag yid gsum bya ba'i dri/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi rgyas btab kyi sbyangs te/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las bzhi/ /'grub pa'i nus pa mthu ldan 'jog par shog /zab gsal gnyis su med par rab sbyor ba'i/ /mtshan bcas rnal 'byor mchog la sems brtan nas/ /de nyid la sems mtshan med rnal 'byor bcas/ /las kyi rgyal po mchog ni 'grub gyur cig /de ltar bsgoms dang bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas rang rgyud smin byas nas/ /gzhan dag rjes 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad kyang*/ /rnam snang go 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig /ces pa ste/ 'di la tshigs bcad bcu gcig yod la/ smon lam sngon ma la nyer drug snang ngo*/ /shis brjod ni/ nam mkha'i khyon kun til gyi gang bu ltar/ /yongs su khyab pa'i kun rig lha tshogs ni/ kha cig me tog char 'bebs shis pa brjod/ /gzhan dag bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ khyed la dpal gnas mdzad par shes gyis dang*/ /shis brjod 'phreng ba bdag gis bsgrag par bya/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rnam snang dze ta ri/ /kun snying sangs rgyas gsang ba byang chub mchog /rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras la sogs pa/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ khyed kyi mi mthun rgud pa kun sel zhing*/ /bde legs yang ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel gyur nas/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /bde gshegs rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sogs/ /bcom ldan thams cad rig pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kun gyi rgyal po mchog /dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud rgyal dang*/ /rab 'byams zhing na rgyud 'di'i tshig don gyi/ /phyogs gcig 'dzin par byed pa'i dge 'dun la/

/legs tshogs= khyed kyi= /bde legs= /phun tshogs= /nam mkha'i khyon ltar ram/ yang na/ rab yangs mtho zhing mdzes pa'i pho brang mchog /nyi zla'i 'od 'phro rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ / dkyil 'khor lha rnams 'du shing 'phro ba'i gzhi/ /ye shes rang bzhin gzhal yas khang chen la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ khyed kyi= /bde legs= /phun tshogs dpal la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bla brgyud bstod pa smon lam shis brjod mdor bsdus pa'i rnams ni bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la dgos mi dgos ji ltar yang rang skal du sbyar ba'o/ / gzhan yang*/ bde gshegs rigs lnga rgyal ba yum bzhi dang*/ /sems dpa' bcu drug sgeg sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /sgo ba bzhi dang rtsa lha sum cu bdun/ / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /che ba'i che mchog ston pa bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang bsrung ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ /bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /ces kun rig gi chog bsgrigs 'di ni/ dad ldan du mas kun rig 'di rang gzhan rnams la tshe phyi mar ma zad tshe 'dir yang pha ma las kyang drin che bar snang bas chog bsgrigs 'di lta bu zhig byas na rang gzhan du ma la phan che bar 'gyur ro zhes pa skul bas rkyen byas te/

'di'i cho ga bris ma 'ga' re 'dug kyang phal cher sgrigs ma shes pa'i lhag chad can dang*/ zlos pa'i skyon che bar mthong nas/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyi phyag rgya sogs rgyud don gsal bar shes dgos pa'i dbang du byas te ha lam 'don cha dang mthun par bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ gnas brtan blo bzang rin chen/ bstan 'dzin dpal bzang*/ kun dga' nor bu gsum gyis dad pas par gyi yi ge ba byas shing*/ the po sku skyes par shing gi mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas par du bsgrubs pa'i dge bas/ rang gzhan rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /bkra shis par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/kun rig gi chog bsgrigs ngag 'don bya tshul 'jug ngogs bde ba'i lam zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 172--PAGE 173--PAGE 86-
